title: SyncTray profile file
description: Authoritative per-profile file (~/.config/synctray/profiles/{shortId}.profile.json). Hand-editing this file and saving live-applies through SyncTray's reconcile path. Dropping a NEW file with an unknown, well-formed `id` CREATES that profile (persisted always; the launchd agent installs only when the new profile is `isEnabled` and has all required fields filled in) — creation-via-file is supported, not just editing an existing profile. Keep this file's `properties` in lockstep with SyncProfile.CodingKeys (SyncTray/Models/SyncProfile.swift) — verified by scripts/check-schema-in-sync.sh.

$schema.description: Reference to this schema file. Written automatically; safe to ignore.

id.description: Stable profile identifier. Do not change — a changed id is treated as a different profile.

name.description: Display name shown in the SyncTray UI.

localSyncPath.description: Local folder path synced with the remote.

drivePathToMonitor.description: External drive mount point to monitor (empty if not on an external drive).

additionalRcloneFlags.description: Extra flags appended to the rclone command.

isEnabled.description: Whether the scheduled sync agent is installed. Toggling this installs or uninstalls the launchd agent.

isMuted.description: Whether file-change notifications are muted for this profile.

fallbackRemote.description: Fallback rclone remote used when the primary is unreachable (empty = no fallback).

fallbackRemotePath.description: Path on the fallback remote (empty = same as remotePath).

fallbackRequiresCacheRebuild.description: Whether primary/fallback use different rclone wire types, forcing a full REMOTE swap on failover instead of an env-var override.
